results.kind: caret specifies that DefaultGray/RGB/CMYK remapping is according to the transparency group XObject's resource dictionary
results.result: ADR 0551 identifies the former ambiguity and current form-resource path. `transparency_groups.rs::the_blending_space_is_the_one_in_force_rather_than_the_one_declared` uses a group-owned default and asserts the selected blending space; separate paint-path assertions cover output. results.kind: producer wording and reader-support wording corrections; Table 6 changed from files 'support' to processors 'shall support'
results.result: Current table-closure assertion enumerates all standard filter spellings; individual decoder tests cover outputs. No missing assertion identified.

results.kind: Text note about private ICC tags and implementation-dependent use
results.result: Informative clarification; ICC parser handles recognized rendering tags and does not make private-tag processing a mandatory feature. No output-conformance gap established.

results.kind: Text note about attribute owners not specifying transformation to other formats
results.result: Informative scope note; reader resolves tagged-PDF attribute ownership, not a required HTML/MathML conversion. Existing owner/inheritance assertions cover the reader-side semantics.

results.kind: insertion '(implementation dependent)' after order is unspecified/unpredictable
results.result: Confirms implementation latitude for replication order; existing bounded tile-prefix behavior and report are documented in ADR0477. No required exact tile order.

results.kind: strike 'shall be' and insert 'is' in statement that stream bytes encrypted/decrypted are given by Length
results.result: Descriptive wording; stream-length producer rule remains §7.3.8. Encryption/decryption uses encoded stream length; existing length/encryption tests cover it. No new behavior found.

results.kind: strike requirement that EmbeddedFiles name tree contain exactly one payload entry
results.result: Deletes a producer cardinality restriction; reader already exposes attachments generically. No new single-entry consumer requirement.

results.result: Corrects source references; crypt.rs padding code already uses step (a) and existing owner-password vectors exercise it.
